title: The Brawl Recap
lines: Welcome to the Brawl Recap, the SmallBall podcast nobody asked for. Well, almost nobody. This one's for GCool, who asked for it. GCool, this episode is yours, buddy.
Shout out to GCool. I'm Marge, he's Dusty, and we are here to break down the Black Friday Brawl. Twenty-three clubs, double elimination, Friday night into Saturday morning.
And Marge, the big story before a single pitch: no match clock.
Right. Either club could start the game, and if somebody had to step away for a minute, they got some grace. Play as fast as you can, be cool about it. It worked.
Forty-five games, five hundred and forty-six runs, fifteen shutouts. That's a lot of baseball for a holiday weekend.
Let's set the seeds. Number one, ArchHen's Flying Lavender Zebras. Number two, QUILL's Green Sox. Number three, N star S and the Ajax Assassins. And number four, Slip's Terrapin Station.
Remember that number three seed. We're coming back to it.
Round of thirty-two. And Dusty, the little clubs showed up.

They did! Jacksonyoung's three star Maple Heights Mustangs beat Band of Bands six to two. Superbeast's five star Small Ballers beat ZigZags five to two. And Ecky's Pure Sadness, a four star club, took out Kingdom Keys.
Pure Sadness. Best club name in the bracket, and they won a game. I love it.
Tightest game of the opening round? Diablow's UT Legends over Trump Train, one to nothing.
Then the round of sixteen, where the big seeds flexed. Flying Lavender Zebras, twenty-one to nothing. Ajax, sixteen to two. Terrapin, eleven to nothing.
But the number two seed did not survive. ArchHen's other club, TBA X S T, shut out Green Sox ten to nothing.
And that's the thing about ArchHen. Two clubs in this tournament, and they both finished top four.
Now the upset of the night. Mr. Crowley's Infidels, the eleven seed, against LSU Fighting Tigers, the six seed. Infidels win, twelve to ten.
And then Infidels almost did it again in the quarterfinal. They lost to Ajax by two. Eleven to nine.
Hold that thought on Mr. Crowley too. He's going to show up again at the end.
Semifinals. Terrapin Station gets the number one seed, Flying Lavender Zebras, and wins twelve to two. Big night for the commish's club.
And on the other side, the moment that made this tournament. TBA beats Ajax eleven to four.
So N star S drops to the losers bracket. One more loss and you're done. That's the whole tournament for Ajax from that point on. Every game is an elimination game.
TBA then edges Terrapin three to one in the winners final and goes to wait in the grand final. They're sitting pretty.
Meanwhile, down in the losers bracket, somebody was on fire. Supr sixty-five's LSU Fighting Tigers.

LSU! After that Infidels upset, they went twenty-nine to nothing over Kingdom Keys. Ten to eight over Turtles All the Way Down. Then a rematch with Infidels, and LSU gets their revenge, thirteen to nine.
Then eleven to one over Trump Train. Four straight elimination wins, seventy-eight runs for the night. That's a run.
Some other losers bracket gems. Rgbartley's Sandlot Bully put up the biggest score of the whole tournament. Thirty-seven to nothing.
Thirty-seven. Somebody check on Maple Heights.
And Jwizz's Immortal Hostilians won two straight games, two to one, both of them. Ice in the veins.
So now, losers round six. LSU, the hottest club in the building, meets Ajax.
And Ajax ends it. Twenty-three to five. LSU's run is over, and they finish fifth.
Next up for Ajax, Flying Lavender Zebras. That one never got played. The organizer recorded it seven to nothing and Ajax moved on.
Which sets up the losers final. Ajax against Terrapin Station. Winner goes to the grand final.
And Ajax wins eleven to three. Slip's Terrapin finishes third. Proud run, but not tonight.
So here's the grand final, Marge. TBA came up through the winners bracket. They've never lost. Ajax came the hard way. And in double elimination, Ajax has to beat them twice.
Game one. Ajax fifteen, TBA one.
Fifteen to one! Now TBA has a loss too, and we get the reset. One game, winner takes everything.
Game two. Ajax eighteen, TBA seven.
Champions! The Ajax Assassins win the Black Friday Brawl! N star S goes seven and one, with a hundred and five runs. And the one club that beat them? He beat them twice to make sure.
That's revenge, Dusty. That's the stuff.
Let's hand out the hardware. Ajax takes the Field of Dreams stadium. Both grand finalists, Ajax and TBA, get a Quick Train.
Best club at six stars and under wins the Batting Camp, and that's Small Ballers, the five star club from superbeast. Fourteenth place against a field full of nine stars. Respect.
And the MVC, the Most Valuable Chatter, voted by the chat. Mr. Crowley!
And he earned it on the field too. Infidels pulled the upset of the night and finished ninth. His other club, Trump Train, won four games and finished eighth.
Two clubs in the top ten and the chat's favorite. Great night, Mr. Crowley.
One more thing. Because Ajax won the Brawl, N star S started Hold the Hill season one as the Ace. So if you want a piece of the champ, you know where to find him.
That's the Brawl Recap. Thanks to everybody who played, everybody who chatted, and one more time, thank you GCool for asking for this one.
See you at the next one. Keep it small, swing it big.
